description.zh: 补齐双方账单和回单资料并逐票核对
description.en: Collect both ledgers and reconcile every shipment

template.zh:
请补齐以下回单对账资料：

1. 对账范围：对账对象 <客户、承运商或司机名称>，账期 <对账月份或周期>，币种 <币种>
2. 对齐规则：优先按 <运单号、客户单号或车牌＋发车日＋线路> 对齐
3. 我方运单费用：@<我方运单费用表>
4. 我方费用表应包含：<运单号或对齐键>、<线路>、<基础运费及各项附加费>、<我方应付或应收金额>
5. 回单资料：@<回单登记或回单文件>
6. 回单资料应包含：<运单号>、<回单状态>、<应回日期>、<实际回收日期或当前持有人>
7. 对方账单：@<客户或承运商账单>
8. 结算规则：<必须原件、认可电子回单或无需回单>
9. 差异规则：普通差异阈值 <差异阈值> 元，大额差异阈值 <大额差异阈值> 元

请逐票匹配并核对，单列费用差异、缺失回单、超期回单和无法匹配项，生成对账单草稿；暂不入账、付款或修改回单状态。
template.en:
Please complete the following POD reconciliation details:

1. Scope: counterparty <Customer, carrier, or driver>, period <Reconciliation period>, currency <Currency>
2. Match key: <Waybill, customer reference, or plate plus date plus route>
3. Our charges: @<Internal shipment charge file>
4. The file must include <Waybill or match key>, <Route>, <Base freight and surcharges>, <Our payable or receivable>
5. POD data: @<POD register or files>
6. POD data must include <Waybill number>, <POD status>, <POD due date>, <Received date or current holder>
7. Counterparty bill: @<Customer or carrier bill>
8. Settlement rule: <Original required, electronic accepted, or POD not required>
9. Variance rules: standard <Variance threshold>, large <Large variance threshold>

Match and reconcile each shipment, listing fee variances, missing and overdue PODs, and unmatched items. Generate a draft statement without posting, paying, or changing POD status.

zh: 客户、承运商或司机名称
运单号、客户单号或车牌＋发车日＋线路
基础运费及各项附加费
实际回收日期或当前持有人
必须原件、认可电子回单或无需回单
en: Waybill, customer reference, or plate plus date plus route
Original required, electronic accepted, or POD not required

description.zh: 补齐开票资料和运单明细并生成申请草稿
description.en: Collect invoice data and prepare an application

template.zh:
请补齐以下开票资料：

1. 开票客户：客户全称 <客户开票抬头>，本次涉及 <运单票数> 票
2. 发票要求：发票类型 <增值税专票、普票或电子普票>，货物或服务名称 <开票项目名称>
3. 金额税率：开票金额 <开票金额> 元，金额口径 <含税或未税>，税率 <税率>%
4. 运单对应：@<运单号、单票金额和线路清单>
5. 基础资料：税号 <纳税人识别号>，注册地址 <注册地址>，联系电话 <开票联系电话>
6. 银行资料：开户行 <开户行全称>，银行账号 <银行账号>
7. 专票资料：一般纳税人资格及资料 @<专票资质文件；非专票填不适用>
8. 交付方式：<电子票接收邮箱，或纸票收件人、电话和邮寄地址>
9. 账期进度：期望开票日期 <期望开票日期>，客户账期 <客户账期>
10. 开票依据：@<确认对账单、合同或其他开票依据>

请先检查资料完整性以及运单金额合计是否与开票金额一致，再生成开票清单、申请内容和进度表；暂不正式提交开票。
template.en:
Please complete the following billing details:

1. Customer: legal invoice name <Invoice title>, shipments <Shipment count>
2. Invoice: <VAT special, general, or electronic general>, item <Invoice item name>
3. Amount: <Invoice amount>, basis <Tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive>, rate <Tax rate>%
4. Shipment mapping: @<Waybill, per-shipment amount, and route list>
5. Registration: tax ID <Tax ID>, address <Registered address>, phone <Invoice phone>
6. Bank: <Bank name>, account <Bank account>
7. Special VAT documents: @<VAT qualification file or not applicable>
8. Delivery: <Electronic email or paper recipient, phone, and address>
9. Progress: desired issue date <Desired invoice date>, terms <Customer terms>
10. Basis: @<Confirmed statement, contract, or other billing basis>

Check completeness and that shipment totals match the invoice amount, then prepare the billing list, application, and tracker. Do not submit the invoice.

确认对账单、合同或其他开票依据
en: VAT special, general, or electronic general
Waybill, per-shipment amount, and route list

description.zh: 补齐应收和账期信息并生成催收方案
description.en: Collect receivable facts and prepare a collection plan

template.zh:
请补齐以下回款催收资料：

1. 客户信息：客户 <客户名称>，内部负责人 <业务或财务负责人>
2. 发票信息：发票号或账单号 <发票号或账单号>，开票日期 <开票日期>
3. 应收金额：开票金额 <开票金额> 元，已回款 <已回款金额> 元，币种 <币种>
4. 账期规则：<开票后、对账确认后、月结固定日或回单齐全后起算>
5. 起算到期：起算日 <账期起算日>，账期 <账期天数或付款规则>，约定到期日 <到期日>
6. 回款情况：最近回款日期和金额 <最近回款情况；没有则填无>
7. 沟通记录：最后跟进日期 <最后跟进日期>，客户最近回复或付款承诺 <最近回复或承诺>
8. 争议情况：<金额、回单、发票或服务争议；没有则填无>
9. 付款方式：<电汇、承兑或其他>；如为承兑，补充 <票号、承兑到期日和是否兑付>
10. 关联资料：@<发票、对账单、运单或历史沟通记录>

请计算未收余额、账龄、当前节点和下一跟进时间，生成分阶段催收话术及风险提示；暂不发送消息、升级法务或创建定时任务。
template.en:
Please complete the following collection details:

1. Customer: <Customer name>, owner <Business or finance owner>
2. Invoice: <Invoice or statement number>, issue date <Invoice date>
3. Receivable: invoiced <Invoiced amount>, paid <Paid amount>, currency <Currency>
4. Terms basis: <Invoice date, reconciliation date, fixed monthly date, or POD completion>
5. Due calculation: start <Terms start date>, terms <Terms or net days>, due <Due date>
6. Payments: <Latest payment date and amount or none>
7. Follow-up: last contact <Last follow-up date>, latest response or promise <Latest response or promise>
8. Disputes: <Amount, POD, invoice, service dispute, or none>
9. Payment method: <Wire, acceptance, or other>; if acceptance, <Acceptance number, maturity, and redemption status>
10. Related records: @<Invoice, statement, waybill, or communication history>

Calculate open balance, aging, current node, and next follow-up, then draft staged collection scripts and risks. Do not message, escalate legally, or create automations.

zh: 开票后、对账确认后、月结固定日或回单齐全后起算
发票、对账单、运单或历史沟通记录
en: Invoice date, reconciliation date, fixed monthly date, or POD completion

票号、承兑到期日和是否兑付
